criterion.name: lean_axiom_report
criterion.description: 1.0 when Lean reports fixture_main depends only on propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice. Between 0 and 1 when the file compiles but still depends on sorryAx: that band orders the search and never establishes that the theorem is proved.

preflight.name: fixture_present
argv: import pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path('fixture.lean'); sys.exit(0 if p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size > 0 else 'fixture.lean is missing or empty')

preflight.name: locked_footer_present
argv: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('fixture.lean').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); sys.exit(0 if '-- LOCKED FOOTER: do not edit or delete.' in t else 'the locked footer was removed; it is what pins the proposition')
